subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should the iOS phone Control hub duplicate Chat and Talk as prominent cards while keeping them as root tabs?
rationale: The code path is now narrow and proof-backed, but the PR body explicitly calls this duplication a product choice intended for visual review.

options.title: Approve the current narrowed layout
options.body: Accept the flat header, Chat/Talk cards, and continuous destination list as the default iPhone Control hub direction once exact-head checks are satisfactory.

options.title: Request a different Control IA
options.body: Keep the branch open but ask for a revised layout that avoids duplicate root-tab shortcuts or changes their emphasis.

options.title: Close in favor of current main
options.body: Reject the product direction and keep the existing grouped Control layout plus the already-merged adjacent row-density and native-iOS polish work.

recommendation.title: Approve the current narrowed layout
recommendation.body: Accept the flat header, Chat/Talk cards, and continuous destination list as the default iPhone Control hub direction once exact-head checks are satisfactory.
